name: Larkie billing assistant
description: Chat assistant in the customer app and website that answers billing, meter reading and tariff questions
purpose: Answer routine billing questions and hand over to a person when unsure or when the customer asks
affected_people: Domestic and small business customers, including customers in vulnerable circumstances
human_oversight: Handover to an agent on request, after two unresolved answers, or when a priority services flag is present; weekly transcript sampling
notes: Art 50 disclosure at the start of every chat; supplier retention capped at 30 days

name: Call summary assistant
description: Listens to contact centre calls and drafts a summary and next steps for the agent to confirm
purpose: Cut after-call typing and improve the quality of account notes
affected_people: Customers who phone us; contact centre agents
human_oversight: Agent reads and confirms every summary before it is saved; monthly quality sample of 50 calls
notes: Agents are told the tool is in use; the call recording notice was updated

name: Complaint triage
description: In-house model that reads new complaints and suggests an urgency band and a team
purpose: Suggest urgency and routing so that serious complaints are seen first
human_oversight: A handler confirms or changes the urgency band on every complaint; no complaint is closed automatically
notes: Pilot covers email complaints only; fairness test results are due before the pilot is widened

name: Priority support flag suggestions
description: Proposed model that suggests customers who may need priority support, based on contact patterns
purpose: Suggest customers for a welfare check or an offer of priority services
affected_people: Customers, including people in vulnerable circumstances
notes: Do not build until classification, a data protection impact assessment and legal review are complete
